crop.notes: The left edge of the column is clipped, so the first letters of many lines are missing. The item about the Sullivan-Ryan fight is otherwise complete.

ocr.notes: Gist readable; line starts are lost to the cropped edge and many words are garbled.

title.suggested: St. Louis Experts Favor Sullivan over Ryan, Citing Allen's Win over Goss

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that St. Louis sporting men expected John L. Sullivan to beat Paddy Ryan, noting Ryan took an hour and a half to whip Joe Goss while Tom Allen had beaten Goss in thirty minutes.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, January 16, 1882, page 6 (day partly blurred; Monday matches the 16th).

facts.fact: St. Louis sporting men said Allen had beaten Joe Goss in thirty minutes when Goss was in his prime

notes: The current title ('Mace and Allen Championship Contest') is wrong: the item is about the coming Sullivan-Ryan fight, and Allen is mentioned once. The claim that Allen beat Goss in thirty minutes is the local experts' recollection; Goss beat Allen on a foul in 1876, so the claim may refer to an earlier English fight.
